evidence.dominant_driver: Ueda explicitly reaffirmed further rate increases as economy and inflation evolve while saying financial conditions remain accommodative.

absorption.reason: The conditional hiking path was already expected and the speech did not accelerate timing; initial market response was limited.

observed_reaction.USDJPY: around 158.2 during speech; no clear yen strengthening

observations.local: JGB yields remain historically high; NI225 positive

evidence.decision_notes: No ACTIONABLE leakage-safe learning profile content was available to alter confidence. Residual-move target from decision time; story delayed/partly priced.

immediate.rationale: Hawkish continuation guidance, but no accelerated timetable and market reaction was limited.

next_session.rationale: Higher-for-longer BOJ path is a valuation headwind if JGB yields stay elevated.

15m.rationale: Speech is already partly absorbed; no clear immediate equity confirmation.

1h.rationale: Hawkish language offset by no timing acceleration and supportive risk tone.

next_session.rationale: Residual risk from higher Japanese rates if local yields remain firm.

predictions.mechanism: BOJ normalization -> higher domestic discount rates / potential yen support -> equity valuation headwind.
predictions.invalidation: JGB yields fall and NI225 extends higher despite the speech.
